description: Reinstalls the server's OS in place: the disk is ERASED, the IP stays. Needs confirm: true and the server's exact label; without both it only describes what would happen. Linux: pass ssh_public_key; without it a new random root password is returned once and stays in the chat history. Windows gets a new Administrator password. Runs on Vultr servers.

confirm.description: true reinstalls; without it the tool only describes what would happen.

label.description: The server's exact label, as a second check.

ssh_public_key.description: Public key line installed for root after the reinstall.

name: reinstall_server
title: Reinstall the OS
